name: generate_vector_illustration
description: Generate a vector graphic (logo, icon, mark, or stylized illustration) from a text prompt and insert it into a Figma file as editable vectors. Set `kind: "icon"` for a small single-concept glyph, mark, or logo that must stay legible at UI sizes, and `kind: "illustration"` for a larger multi-element scene or spot illustration. The generation strategy is chosen server-side; the user only sees the final vector node. Use this for logo, icon, and vector-illustration requests. Do NOT use it for photographic or photorealistic image generation. Use an editable Design or Slides file. If no editable file exists, call create_new_file first. Use currentPageId to select a page and parentNodeId to place inside an existing node. Returns fileKey, nodeId, kind, width, and height. **This is a paid feature — each call consumes Figma AI credits against the destination file's plan (different models have different per-call costs).**

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to use. If the URL is provided, extract the file key from the URL. The given URL must be in the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:int1-:int2. The extracted fileKey would be `:fileKey`.

prompt.description: Text description of the vector illustration to generate, e.g. "a fox jumping over a fence, flat vector style".

kind.description: What kind of vector to generate. Use "icon" for a small single-concept glyph, mark, or logo built from a few shapes that must stay legible at UI sizes. Use "illustration" for a larger multi-element scene or spot illustration. Defaults to "illustration".

width.description: Integer width in pixels between 16 and 2048.

height.description: Integer height in pixels between 16 and 2048.

currentPageId.description: The GUID of the page to target. Always pass this when available. Use the page the user is currently viewing unless the request explicitly refers to a different page.

parentNodeId.description: Optional parent container GUID on the destination page, e.g. "123:456" (convert URL-form "123-456" to colon form). Nested instance IDs ("I123:456;789:012") are unsupported. Omit to insert at the page root near the viewport center.
